Command.Name: ReadDailyAmountsByVAT
Command.FPOperation: Provides information about the accumulated amounts and refunded amounts by VAT class in case that CU regularly informs about the Z report(7C)

Res.Name: SaleVATGrA
Res.Desc: Up to 15 symbols for the accumulated VAT in group A

Res.Name: SaleVATGrB
Res.Desc: Up to 15 symbols for the accumulated VAT in group B

Res.Name: SaleVATGrC
Res.Desc: Up to 15 symbols for the accumulated VAT in group C

Res.Name: SaleVATGrD
Res.Desc: Up to 15 symbols for the accumulated VAT in group D

Res.Name: SaleTurnoverVATGrE
Res.Desc: Up to 15 symbols for the accumulated turnover in group E

Res.Name: SaleTurnoverABCD
Res.Desc: Up to 15 symbols for the sale turnover in VAT groups A, B, C, D

Res.Name: RefundVATGrA
Res.Desc: Up to 15 symbols for the refund VAT in group A

Res.Name: RefundVATGrB
Res.Desc: Up to 15 symbols for the refund VAT in group B

Res.Name: RefundVATGrC
Res.Desc: Up to 15 symbols for the refund VAT in group C

Res.Name: RefundVATGrD
Res.Desc: Up to 15 symbols for the refund VAT in group D

Res.Name: RefundTurnoverVATGrE
Res.Desc: Up to 15 symbols for the refund accumulated turnover in group E

Res.Name: RefundTurnoverABCD
Res.Desc: Up to 15 symbols for the refund turnover in VAT groups A, B, C, D
